source_title: New self-serve plans for Devin
claim_summary: Core and Team plans retired for Free, Pro ($20/month), Max ($200/month), Teams (usage-based, $80/month minimum) and Enterprise; Ask Devin Deep Mode, Devin Review (after a 2-week trial) and new higher-quality DeepWiki modes move to usage-based billing; existing DeepWiki generation and Devin Review for open-source repos stay free; reviews set to run on every commit are migrated to run when a PR is first opened
availability: vendor-announced; effective billing dates per customer not verified
limitation: Prices quoted from the vendor post only; no invoice or terms-of-service check; the free-for-open-source condition is not defined on the page

source_title: Introducing SWE-Check: 10x Faster Bug Detection
claim_summary: RL-trained bug-detection model; vendor reports parity with Opus 4.6 on internal in-distribution evals (delta F1 0.09 to 0) while remaining behind on out-of-distribution evals, at roughly 10x faster runtime
availability: in product per Desktop changelog v2.3.9 (2026-05-16) fixing swe-check availability
limitation: Internal evals only; no independent replication; out-of-distribution gap stated by vendor

source_title: Devin in Windsurf
claim_summary: Windsurf 2.0 adds the Agent Command Center and the Devin cloud agent inside the IDE; Devin Cloud rolls out gradually, is disabled by default for enterprise accounts, and first launch adds up to 50 USD of extra usage
availability: gradual rollout; enterprise off by default (Desktop changelog v2.0.44)
limitation: Rollout completeness not observable; no independent test of hand-off fidelity

source_title: Release notes April 15, 2026: Close PR or Convert to Draft in Review UI
claim_summary: PR review merge bar gains close-PR and convert-to-draft actions directly from the review page
feature: PR lifecycle control in review UI
limitation: Carried forward from the 2026-10-14 supplement and re-verified; AI review is not independent human sign-off

source_title: Devin CLI: Start Local, Hand Off to the Cloud
claim_summary: Terminal agent that starts locally and hands the same session to the cloud; installed via a curl-to-bash script; Desktop changelog v2.1.29 (2026-04-29) states all Windsurf users can use it with existing subscription
availability: available to Windsurf subscribers per 2026-04-29 changelog
limitation: Pipe-to-shell installation is a supply-chain trust decision; installer not inspected; no permission audit

source_title: Engineering in the fast lane: Mercedes-Benz partners with Cognition
claim_summary: Vendor states a four-week pilot in which Devin analysed over 200,000 lines of COBOL and cut an estimated eight-month modernisation to eight days, followed by wider deployment
limitation: Customer statement not independently confirmed; baseline 'eight months' is an estimate; no accepted-task denominator

source_title: Release notes April 29, 2026: PR Auto-Close Removed
claim_summary: Sessions no longer automatically close their pull requests when the session ends; open PRs stay open by default
limitation: Shifts open-PR cleanup to maintainers; effect on stale-PR burden unmeasured

source_title: Desktop changelog v2.2.17 (May 6, 2026): Devin Review & Quick Review
claim_summary: Devin Review and Quick Review available to all Windsurf IDE users with existing subscription; enterprise users can only use Devin Review with a Cognition platform agreement
limitation: Contract terms not public

source_title: Release notes May 8, 2026: Devin Review API
claim_summary: Reviews can be triggered programmatically via POST /v3/organizations/{org_id}/pr-reviews with a service-user token or PAT, e.g. from CI
limitation: Endpoint not exercised; token scope and rate limits untested

source_title: Introducing Auto-Triage
claim_summary: Devin monitors alerts and bug reports (Slack, Linear, GitHub checks, Sentry, Datadog, webhooks), investigates, spins up sub-Devins and can open a PR
limitation: No published false-positive or bad-PR rate; autonomy increases review load

source_title: More Devins in More Places
claim_summary: Raised over $1B at a $26B valuation led by Lux Capital, General Catalyst and 8VC; run-rate revenue $492M; enterprise usage >10x since start of year; says 89% of code committed by its engineers is committed by Devin
limitation: Revenue and self-use figures unaudited; page later edited without notice: the 2026-05-27 Wayback capture says 'local agents in Windsurf' where the live page says 'Devin Desktop'; a Bloomberg link with the same figures was seen only as a Hacker News title

source_title: Release notes May 29, 2026: Automations: Files-Changed Trigger
claim_summary: Automation builder supports file-change triggers for GitHub push events, running only when specified files or directories change
limitation: Carried forward and re-verified; token scope and permissions untested

source_title: Introducing Devin Desktop
claim_summary: Windsurf renamed Devin Desktop (v3.0.12) with the Agent Command Center as default, Agent Client Protocol support for third-party agents, and Devin Local as successor to Cascade; vendor says plan, pricing and extensions unchanged and the IDE stays backwards-compatible with Windsurf
limitation: ACP interoperability not tested; brand change complicates longitudinal tracking

source_title: AI should earn its keep: Introducing the AI Productivity Guarantee
claim_summary: Enterprise offer: if Devin delivers less engineering value than paid, Cognition funds usage up to $10M; value is estimated by an AI agent that grades each session's usefulness and human-equivalent hours, validated against customer engineers' time estimates
limitation: Vendor's own agent grades vendor's agent output (sessions with unmerged PRs count as not useful); no independent audit of the estimator

source_title: Introducing FrontierCode
claim_summary: Vendor-built benchmark scoring code quality beyond correctness, with a leaderboard; refined as FrontierCode 1.1 on 2026-07-07 (relaxed 75 of 1000+ grading criteria)
limitation: Benchmark author also sells the ranked agent; later Cognition claims (Fusion, SWE-1.7, SWE-2) use it

source_title: Release notes June 10, 2026: Pending PR Reviews Canceled on New Commits
claim_summary: In-progress Devin reviews are cancelled when new commits are pushed; PR Review API exposes a cancelled status
limitation: Carried forward and re-verified; fresh-head CI still needed

source_title: terraform-provider-devin v0.1.0
claim_summary: Apache-2.0 Terraform provider repository created 2026-06-16; releases v0.1.0 (2026-06-16) to v0.3.0 (2026-09-30) in window; Aug 7 release notes add a devin_automation resource
limitation: Provider not executed; v0.4.0 (2026-10-15) is post-window

source_title: Release notes June 17, 2026: Devin Review: Security Findings
claim_summary: All reviews include a security-findings section that respects the repository's SECURITY.md; on 2026-09-16 the security-scan toggle was removed so security bugs are always checked
limitation: Detection quality and SECURITY.md adherence untested

source_title: Devin Fusion: Frontier Performance at 35% Lower Cost (title at publication)
claim_summary: Multi-model harness with sidekick agents and dynamic routing; at publication claimed frontier and Fable 5-level performance at 35% lower cost on FrontierCode
limitation: Vendor benchmark only; headline later revised (see 2026-08-07 row); Wayback captures 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-15 show the 35% figure

source_title: Introducing Devin Security Swarm
claim_summary: Parallel agents find vulnerabilities, validate exploitability at runtime and open remediation PRs; vendor eval on 50 post-cutoff vulnerabilities in 14 languages reports 72% recall at roughly two-thirds the cost of the next most accurate tool
limitation: Vendor-built 50-item eval; competitors and false-positive rate not independently checked

source_title: SWE-1.7: Frontier Intelligence at a Fraction of the Cost
claim_summary: Model RL-trained from a Kimi K2.7 base, available in Devin Web, Desktop and CLI via Cerebras at 1000 TPS; vendor reports 42.3% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main
limitation: Base-model licence terms not checked; scores on vendor-owned benchmark

source_title: Devin is Now FedRAMP High In-Process
claim_summary: Entire platform listed as FedRAMP Class D (High) In-Process, extending prior status of Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) to Devin Cloud
limitation: FedRAMP Marketplace listing not fetched; 'In-Process' is not authorization

source_title: Release notes July 17, 2026: Centralized Skill Management via Plugins
claim_summary: Skills distributed via centrally governed plugins apply across Devin Cloud, CLI and Desktop; on 2026-09-18 Knowledge notes began migrating automatically into Skills
limitation: Plugin format portability to other agents not checked

source_title: Release notes July 22, 2026: Devin Outposts
claim_summary: Runs Devin workloads in the customer's own environment; disabled by default, enabled via Cognition representative at launch
availability: off by default at launch; current docs (accessed 2026-10-16) say available on Pro, Max and Teams
limitation: Carried forward and re-verified; later availability statement is post-window documentation and mutable; MIT reference operator CognitionAI/devin-outpost-k8s created 2026-07-12

source_title: Welcoming The Interaction Company
claim_summary: The Interaction Company of California, maker of the Poke personal agent, joins Cognition (also TierZero on 2026-07-20 and Dioxus Labs on 2026-09-10)
limitation: Deal terms undisclosed; vendor's Poke usage figure not checked

source_title: How Do AI Coding Agents Contribute to Software Development? An Empirical Study of Agentic Pull Requests
claim_summary: Independent study of 220,612 closed PRs in 489 Python repositories (AIDev dataset) reports GLMM estimated merge probability of 43.0% for Devin PRs, lowest of five agents (Claude 84.3%, Codex 73.5%, Cursor 63.9%, Copilot 59.6%); authors link it to Devin's use in less popular repositories
limitation: Not peer reviewed; data drawn from 2025-era PRs, not the in-window product; merge is not quality; repository-selection confounding acknowledged by authors; the paper gives both 489 and 539 repositories in different sections

source_title: Release notes August 7, 2026: Security Profiles
claim_summary: Security profiles governing network access are generally available, with an org-wide default and per-automation selection; same release makes personal access tokens GA with revocation on loss of membership
limitation: Carried forward and re-verified; no bypass test performed

source_title: Release notes August 7, 2026: Automations API and Terraform Provider
claim_summary: Automations API promoted from beta to the production v3 spec; devin_automation resource added to the Terraform provider
limitation: API not exercised

source_title: Release notes August 7, 2026: Legacy Cascade Disabled by Default for Enterprises
claim_summary: Legacy Cascade defaults to disabled for enterprise tiers (after a 2026-07-31 scope setting to keep it only in the JetBrains plugin)
limitation: Migration cost for users not measured

source_title: Devin Fusion page footnote: data last updated 8/7/2026
claim_summary: Live page now headlines 'up to 60% lower cost' on FrontierCode 1.1 Extended and states 'We initially reported a 35% cost reduction at publication'
limitation: Disclosed revision, but on a newer benchmark version; 2026-08-07 is the data-update date stated on the page, not a verified edit timestamp

source_title: AI Startup Cognition in New Funding Talks at $40B Value (Bloomberg link, HN listing)
claim_summary: A Hacker News submission dated 2026-08-12 links a Bloomberg article titled as reporting funding talks at a $40B valuation
limitation: E0: title only; Bloomberg disallows Claude agents in robots.txt so the article was not read; superseded by the Sep 8 announcement ($48B)

source_title: SpaceX Attempted to Acquire AI Coding Startup Cognition (Bloomberg link, HN listing)
source_publisher: Hacker News listing of Bloomberg and TechCrunch
claim_summary: Bloomberg-linked HN title reports SpaceX attempted to acquire Cognition; a TechCrunch-linked HN title the same day says Cognition's CEO denied the report
limitation: E0: titles only; Bloomberg and TechCrunch disallow Claude agents in robots.txt; no ownership change is evidenced

source_title: Release notes September 2, 2026: Cleanup Scan Type; /scan; Scheduled Scans in Automations
claim_summary: Adds a cleanup scan type for dead code, a /scan composer command and a code-scan agent type in automations for scheduled or per-commit re-scans
limitation: Earlier E0 lead now date-verified on the primary page; detection quality unknown

source_title: Cognition Set to Raise Around $1B at a $47B Valuation (Bloomberg link, HN listing)
claim_summary: Bloomberg-linked HN title reports a raise of around $1B at a $47B valuation
limitation: E0: title only; conflicts with the vendor's Sep 8 figures (over $2B at $48B)

source_title: Do it all with Devin: Announcing our Series E
claim_summary: Raised over $2B at a $48B valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz and Accel; run-rate revenue grew from $492M to almost $900M since May; describes itself as an independent agent lab combining third-party and own models
limitation: Unaudited; on 2026-09-25 vendor states $1B annualised run rate

source_title: Desktop changelog v3.9.19 (September 8, 2026): Cascade has been removed
claim_summary: Cascade removed; Devin Local is the only agent in Devin Desktop, with a prompt to migrate existing conversations
limitation: Completes the Windsurf-agent retirement; user migration losses not measured (one independent reviewer reported old chats not deletable)

source_title: Introducing SWE-2: Pushing the Pareto Frontier
claim_summary: Vendor reports 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within one point of Fable 5.1 at 64% lower cost; available in Devin Desktop and CLI and rolling out on Devin Web
availability: Desktop/CLI per blog; Web release notes (2026-09-21) call it a research preview needing admin enablement
limitation: Availability wording differs between blog and release notes; vendor benchmark

source_title: Welcoming Dioxus to Cognition
claim_summary: Dioxus team joins Cognition; both parties state continued support for open-source Dioxus, Blitz, Taffy and Subsecond
limitation: Future maintenance is a stated intention only; GitHub API reports Apache-2.0 for DioxusLabs/dioxus (accessed 2026-10-16)

source_title: Cognition and AWS team up to help ambitious teams ship more, faster
claim_summary: Multi-year AWS Strategic Collaboration Agreement; Devin purchasable through AWS Marketplace and Agent Toolkit for AWS usable in Devin
limitation: AWS-side confirmation not fetched

source_title: Desktop changelog v3.10.31 (September 16, 2026): Restricted Mode fix (CVE-2026-81376)
claim_summary: Restricted Mode now blocks restricted workspace settings in nested object form (CVE-2026-81376); NVD lists this CVE as a Visual Studio Code flaw (versions before 1.136.2, CVSS 3.1 9.6, published 2026-09-08)
limitation: Eight days between NVD publication and the fork's changelog fix; exploitability in Devin Desktop not tested

source_title: Release notes September 21, 2026: npx devin-review CLI Retired
claim_summary: Standalone npx devin-review tool and its unauthenticated review page removed; installed copies stop working
limitation: No deprecation window stated in the entry; impact on CI users unknown

source_title: Devin AI & SWE-2 First Impressions
claim_summary: After about one week of use the author reports a crowded desktop app, old Windsurf chats visible but not deletable from the full list, and preferring the CLI
limitation: Anecdotal n=1; access arrangement not stated

source_title: Cognition Crosses $1B in Annualized Revenue Run Rate
claim_summary: Vendor states it crossed $1B annualised revenue run rate
limitation: Unaudited; revenue is not evidence of verified usefulness

source_title: Desktop changelog v3.10.48 (September 29, 2026): Sign in with ChatGPT
claim_summary: Users can sign in with ChatGPT and bill GPT model usage in Devin Desktop to an eligible ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan
limitation: OpenAI-side terms not checked

source_title: Factory CEO just accused his VC board advisor of spying for Cognition (TechCrunch link, HN listing)
claim_summary: TechCrunch-linked HN title reports that a rival coding-agent company's CEO accused a board advisor of passing information to Cognition
limitation: E0: title only; TechCrunch disallows Claude agents; X posts not fetched; no finding of wrongdoing is evidenced

source_title: Release notes October 9, 2026: Repository AGENTS.md loaded on setup
claim_summary: When setting up a repository Devin reads the root AGENTS.md and follows its instructions for the session
limitation: Earlier E0 lead (secondary index said Oct 12) now date-verified as Oct 9 on the primary page; adherence untested

source_title: Release notes October 9, 2026: Memory and dreaming; Session resume window is now 14 days
claim_summary: Devin keeps per-user memory across sessions and refines it nightly ('dreaming'), with org and enterprise admin switches; session resume window cut from 30 to 14 days
limitation: Data retention and privacy terms not reviewed

source_title: Desktop changelog v3.10.67 (October 12, 2026)
claim_summary: Adds MCP protocol revision 2026-07-28 support, an enterprise-set extension marketplace URL restricting installs, and a private preview of reaching enterprise remote MCPs configured in Devin Cloud
availability: release; remote MCP part private preview
limitation: Interoperability with other MCP clients not tested
